state_effect_ledger: Lock aw_haptic+0x290; set stop=0; play_mode(2); upload_lra(2).
Startup wait observes node state and stop bit and performs 1 ms delays; a preexisting stop unlocks without rewriting the flag.
On valid start: play_go(1), delay 1 ms, require retry counter > 0; set started=1; unlock aw_haptic+0x290; lock aw_haptic+0x370.
Ensure shared aw_pm_qos_req_vb is active, adding CPU latency QoS request with value 0 only if inactive.
Poll FIFO AES then global state; reject low-nibble zero; read stop byte before FIFO node state.

For valid node and FIFO-ready: log signed 16-bit length, read payload bytes 0,1,0x0a,0x0c, call set_rtp_data(pointer, sign-extended length converted to u32), mark node 0xaa, advance next, update time/count, then sample time without an added delay.
For a nonterminal wait path: udelay(1000), sample time; timeout after 800 ms relative to the current anchor.
Exit/error/timeout path removes QoS only if active, sets stop=1, then unlocks the current mutex; startup preexisting-stop path only unlocks the first mutex.
